name: concord
description: Stay in control while AI agents write your code. A strong model turns each task into a short plan that a verifier challenges and you approve, has the failing tests written first, writes the small changes and checks every result; low-cost models implement the bulky phases within a fixed file scope that every run's report checks; an independent reviewer checks each change at its risk level and a cheap delta review checks each fix; you review the diff and commit. Adds /concord:plan-then-delegate, /concord:delegate and /concord:rules-review, plus implementer and reviewer agents. Needs the dispatcher from the repository's install.sh. Actively developed: new versions ship through this marketplace.
